title: Care Academy Note: Where the Buyer's Cure Document Clock Starts on a Title & Registration Services Order
content:
On a Title & Registration Services order, the buyer's cure document clock is the date from which the buyer's document time is measured when a fee shortage is cured. It starts on the vehicle's actual handover date when a scheduled handover was missed for a reason on Kestrel's side (Kestrel running late or the vehicle not ready) and the handover came after the order's opening date; it starts on the first scheduled handover date when the buyer missed that appointment and that date came after the order's opening date; otherwise it starts on the order's opening date.

## Questions and answers

**Which records decide it?**
The handover appointment under Delivery & Pickup Appointments for the same purchase order shows the cause recorded on its most recent missed attempt (Kestrel late, vehicle not ready, customer unavailable, or none) and the appointment date first booked. The purchase order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements shows the handover date. The title order shows its opening date.

**What counts as a reason on Kestrel's side?**
A missed attempt recorded as Kestrel late or as vehicle not ready.

**What counts as the buyer missing the appointment?**
A missed attempt recorded as customer unavailable; the date used is the appointment date first booked.

**What if the date in question is the opening date itself, or earlier?**
Each of the first two starting points applies only when its date came after the opening date; a handover or first scheduled date on or before the opening date leaves the clock on the opening date.

## Summary table

| Most recent missed-attempt cause | Date compared with the opening date | Clock starts on |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel late or vehicle not ready | actual handover date is after the opening date | the actual handover date |
| customer unavailable | first scheduled handover date is after the opening date | the first scheduled handover date |
| any other case | not relevant | the order's opening date |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- Opened 2 June; appointment first booked for 6 June and missed as vehicle not ready; handed over 9 June. The clock starts 9 June.
- Opened 2 June; appointment first booked for 5 June and missed as customer unavailable; handed over 12 June. The clock starts 5 June.
- Opened 2 June; no missed attempt; handed over 4 June. The clock starts 2 June.
